name: LookAway
author: artemisa81
description: Soften and cover the screen when your AirPods say you looked away. Head-tracked privacy scrim driven by earbud motion sensors.

barWidget.description: Head-tracked privacy scrim driven by earbud motion sensors.

schema.label: Demo feed (no AirPods needed)
schema.description: Run a synthetic orientation sweep so the scrim can be previewed without earbuds.

schema.label: AirPods MAC (optional)
schema.description: Leave empty to auto-detect a paired device named AirPods.

schema.label: Head-tracking start packet
schema.description: auto | alt | def. Auto falls back from alt to def if no sensor stream arrives.

schema.label: Comfort zone (degrees)
schema.description: Head movement inside this cone is ignored.

schema.label: Full cover at (degrees)
schema.description: Angle at which the screen is fully covered.
